Respondent as plaintiff, instituted the aforesaid suit, for a decree, amongst other, declaring the deed of agreement dated 15-6-1993 in between the plaintiff and defendant No. 1-3 being deed No. 6944 for the year of 1993 registered in the office of the Sub-Registrar, Gulshan, Dhaka, stands cancelled and the earnest money paid thereunder has been lawfully forfeited, and direct defendant No. 15-6-1993 in his office. Plaintiff also prayed for declaring that the Power of Attorney executed by the plaintiff in favour of the defendant No. 1, deed No. 6945 for the year of 1993 and further declaring transfer permission in Memo No. RAJUK/ESTATE/270(2) Stha dated 25-1-1995 issued by Deputy Director (Estate), Rajdhani Unnayan Kartipakha, Dhaka as void, ineffective, illegal and not binding on the plaintiff. Also for a decree for declaring any and all sale deed(s) executed and registered by defendant No. 1, purportedly on behalf of plaintiff, is/are of no legal effect and not binding on the plaintiff, a decree declaring plaintiffs right, title and possession in the schedule property, a decree for khas possession of the schedule property, a decree for permanent injunction upon defendant No. 1 not to execute any sale deed, decree for permanent injunction upon defendant No. 6 not to register any sale deed executed by defendant No. 1, a decree for permanent injunction upon defendant No. 5 not to mutate name pursuant to any deed of sale executed by defendant No. 1, a decree for mense profit and /or damages/ compensation for use and occupation of the schedule property. 

 13. Plaintiff seeks as many as 11 reliefs in the plaint. The learned Judge held that, the present suit be partly decreed on contest against defendant No. 1-3 with costs and ex-parte against defendant No. 4-6 without costs. The title of the plaintiff over the schedule property is declared, the deed of agreement being deed No, 6946 dated 15-6-1993 registered in the office of the Sub-Registrar Gulshan, Dhaka stand cancelled and the earnest money paid thereunder has been lawfully forfeited. Learned Judge also declared the power of attorney, deed No. 6946 dated 15-6-1993, registered in the office of the Sub-Registrar Gulshan, Dhaka stand revoked and cancelled. It was further declared that the transfer permission in Memo No. RAJUK/ESTATE/ 270(2) dated 25-1-95 issued by Deputy Director (Estate) Rajdhani Unnayan Kartipakha, Dhaka is void, illegal, ineffective and not binding upon the plaintiff. The learned Judge on consideration of depositions and evidences on record found that plaintiff is entitled to get a decree for khas possession of the schedule properties and directed defendants No. 1-3 to give delivery of possession of the schedule property within 60 (sixty) days from the date of decree to the plaintiff failing which, the plaintiff will be at liberty to recover khas possession through Court as per law. Leaned Judge further decreed that the plaintiff do get mesne profits from the defendant No. 1-3 till recovery of possession of the schedule properties.
